purpose: Define Trigger as the exclusive ! automation primitive: an inert declaration that observes an explicit target, evaluates bounded predicates, and produces an explicit Core-owned automation dispatch request when matched.

semantics.target_rule: Trigger targets an exact symbol or an intentionally declared specific group.
semantics.noisy_root_rule: Whole-root triggers over noisy roots such as #OSC and #REST are forbidden by default.
semantics.payload_target_rule: Payload-selected dynamic Trigger targets are forbidden.
semantics.predicate_rule: Predicates are side-effect-free, bounded and belong to the expression system.
semantics.fire_rule: Trigger match does not directly execute arbitrary commands/effects; it requests explicit Core dispatch.
semantics.definition_state_rule: Trigger definition is inert; edge/timing state is runtime state.

invariants.rule: Automation semantics are explicit, bounded, and do not gain authority from data or composition.

hard_gates.condition: Trigger targets whole #OSC or #REST root by default
Trigger target selected dynamically from payload/model output
Trigger match directly executes arbitrary effect outside dispatcher

references.purpose: Trigger participates in explicit automation causality.
Trigger firing crosses Core dispatcher boundary.

prose.summary: Define Trigger as the exclusive ! automation primitive: an inert declaration that observes an explicit target, evaluates bounded predicates, and produces an explicit Core-owned automation dispatch request when matched.
notes: Unlocked until reconciled against the existing automation/runtime contracts and repository-wide 1.4 traceability validation.
